environment: isolated UI boundaries; persistent semantics tested separately in real PostgreSQL

checks.name: all eight stages: cards as primary structure and one shared save action
bulk operation touches only the selected AND filtered item
pending cost justification blocks consolidation; cancel does not write and restores input
save flushes blur before capture; typing during response preserves DOM, cursor draft and next-save status
global save captures parameters before the autosave timer fires
rejected draft write blocks consolidation and preserves the typed value
double click queues once; lost response retry retains the same idempotency key
paste has a card preview and writes only after explicit confirmation
restricted presentation exposes no sensitive history counts, diffs or technical calculations
chosen dark theme preserves opaque surfaces and text contrast >= 4.5:1
mobile total fits beside or above save controls without overlap
